_comment: Copy to gallery_config.json (git-ignored). Every key is optional; the defaults below are what runs with nothing configured at all.
_backend: local | s3 — 's3' covers any S3-compatible bucket: Backblaze B2, Cloudflare R2. Moving from local disk to a bucket is this line.
_root: local backend only. Where the objects go. Default: TEZA/gallery next to the engine.
_records: mongo | json — mongo is the default and uses db.py, the same store the studio reads its projects from. json keeps records in TEZA/gallery-db and needs no database at all.
_endpoint: s3 backend only. B2 shows this on the bucket page. R2: https://<account-id>.r2.cloudflarestorage.com
_public_base: The CDN origin in front of the bucket, e.g. https://img.example.com. Set it and image URLs point at the CDN — which is where the egress becomes free and where the loading gets fast. Leave empty and the manifest hands out signed URLs that expire instead.
_admin_token: Empty means /api/gallery/* is open, which is correct only while this runs as a localhost sidecar. Set it before the API is reachable from anywhere else.
